What we do

From the first hole in the ground to the last board on the deck, we handle the whole job so you don’t chase five different contractors.

  • Excavator work

    Trenching, foundations, site clearing and digging in tight spots, with a John Deere tracked excavator we bring to your site on our own trailer.

  • Backhoe & loader

    Moving gravel, topsoil and fill, digging footings and rough grading with our Kubota backhoe tractor.

  • Drainage

    Perimeter drains, culverts and trenches that move water away from your house and driveway, and keep it away.

  • Retaining walls

    Pressure-treated timber and interlocking block walls built on a proper base with drainage behind them.

  • Grading, gravel & sod

    Level lots, clean gravel runs and fresh sod so the yard looks finished the day we leave.

  • Decks, carpentry & tile

    Decks, stairs, repairs and tile work, done by the same crew that prepped your site.

Mobile mechanic service

When a tractor or machine goes down, you shouldn’t have to wait on a tow. Our mobile mechanic comes to your site and gets it repaired where it sits.

Our mechanic is a Red Seal heavy-duty mechanic, working on tractors, excavators and other heavy equipment.

We also do scheduled maintenance and tune-ups, so your equipment stays ready before it breaks down.
